title: CreateAppRequest
description: Request body for creating a new Fly App.

app_name.description: The unique name for the new app.

org_slug.description: The slug of the organization that will own this app.

enable_subdomains.description: When true, enables wildcard subdomain routing for this app.

network.description: Name of the private WireGuard network to attach this app to. If omitted, the organization's default network is used.
